subject: Data Structures
definition: Traversing a BST in Inorder (Left -> Root -> Right) always produces elements in strictly ascending sorted order.

subject: Operating Systems
definition: A condition where CPU spends excessive time swapping pages into and out of memory rather than executing instructions, caused by insufficient allocated physical frames.

subject: DBMS
definition: Atomicity (all or nothing), Consistency (preserves validity), Isolation (concurrent safety), Durability (committed changes persist across power failure).

subject: Computer Networks
definition: The connection establishment protocol using SYN -> SYN-ACK -> ACK before actual payload bytes are transmitted.

subject: Python
definition: A mutex in CPython that protects access to Python objects, preventing multiple native threads from executing Python bytecodes simultaneously in a single process.
